The 20 water points recorded on the retired combined form 86cf66ef on 21-24 Aug 2025 by account fitahianawilliam are an identification survey, not managed water points. Four of them were counted in the fleet (987623115, 987623256, 987623270, 987623517) with no works record of any kind, and are excluded. 987623555 stays: it has a final rehabilitation on the Marolinta borehole-progress form dated 26 Aug 2026. The rule is enforced in the build (tools/classify_register.py removes an excluded point from the fleet; check_consistency fails if any fleet point lacks a works record).

asana-evidence-2026-10-05.answer: An Asana task counts as closed only if it is completed AND has evidence: a comment starting "Evidence:" or an attached file. An assignee's tick alone does not close an action: a task completed without evidence shows in amber as "ticked in Asana, no evidence yet", with who ticked it and when, stays open in every count, and after 7 days without evidence is listed under "Ticked without evidence" for Adriaan. Every closed action shows its evidence line, linked to the Asana task. No action counts as closed without an evidence source (Evidence comment, attachment, an existing repository entry, or a build condition met); tools/check_asana.py enforces it.

rule-major-changes-approval-2026-10-07.answer: Changes that move the headline figures (carbon credits tCO2e, water points in scope, people served, days operational) are reviewed every build against last week's edition (tools/change_review.py). Repository edits are never held, being made on Adriaan's or Jan's instruction, but one that moves a headline figure must carry a decision in data/decisions.json with 'instructed_by' (Adriaan Mol or Jan de Graaf) and 'headline' before/after figures; the build fails without one. mWater changes go live and are listed under 'Changes this week', except three, which are provisional until Adriaan or Jan approves one Asana approval task per week ('Approve: major changes [week NN]', assigned to Adriaan, Jan following): (a) an existing record edited so that credits or eligibility go up; (b) a record deleted; (c) a week-on-week move of more than 2% in tCO2e, points in scope or people served not explained by new records or by status changes backed by a record. Pumps marked abandoned, removed or non-functional with a supporting record pass without approval. Changes made by Adriaan or Jan are ignored. No flag, no task. Approvals are recorded in data/decisions.json as approval-major-changes-<week>.
